name: block-dashboard-stats
summary: KPI cards with values, accessible trends, icons, and a loading state for dashboards.
description: A Web block that renders a responsive grid of KPI cards: label, value, optional icon, an optional trend whose color follows whether the change is good news, a secondary line, and skeleton cards while loading. Built from the Card and Skeleton primitives and theme tokens; all copy arrives through props and it fetches nothing.
use_when: a dashboard or overview page needs headline numbers
the builder asks for KPI, metric, or stat cards with a trend
a console home page should summarize usage, revenue, or activity
